invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$2000且RSI跌破50，或融资费率Z-score升至120%以上（进一步过热），或日线趋势恶化。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $2000 with RSI falling below 50, or funding Z-score rises above 120% (further overheating), or daily trend worsens.

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$68000且RSI跌破50，或融资费率转为正且Z-score升至0%以上（空头压力缓解），或日线趋势恶化（如跌破关键支撑）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $68000 with RSI falling below 50, or funding turns positive with Z-score rising above 0% (short pressure eases), or daily trend worsens (e.g., breaks key support).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破$0.092且RSI跌破50，或融资费率Z-score升至180%以上（极度过热），或日线趋势恶化。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below $0.092 with RSI falling below 50, or funding Z-score rises above 180% (extreme overheating), or daily trend worsens.
